architecture:
System: Secure-Analytics-057
Primary NIST family: Contingency Planning (CP); evidence focus: CP-2.
Environment: AWS GovCloud. Network access uses PrivateLink; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: recovery exercises are performed on schedule and corrective actions are tracked. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
